messages:
Noah: Design sprint ask for Friday: create a compact benchmark mini-deck (3 slides) + a single PNG hero for the blog. Keep file size small for email. Need FR localization for slide 3.
Ivy: Clarify content: slide1 = tl;dr metrics, slide2 = visual explainer of caching+batching, slide3 = customer-facing summary (localized FR). Any required wording?
Noah: Use metrics: p50 38ms, $0.00085/token, ~2.9x batching uplift. Wording for hero headline: "Serving that scales, costs that don't." Hero CTA microcopy: "Read the benchmark".
Diego: Motion note: for blog hero, a subtle pulsing token counter (1s pulse) is ok. Keep GIF under 800KB. For slides prefer static SVGs.
Zara: Brand constraints: avoid Accent Yellow as main background. Use Primary Blue or white. Ensure all CTAs have 16px touch target and 4.5:1 contrast. Export sizes: hero 1200x628 PNG, slides PDF (A4) and PPTX. File names: mini_bench_deck_v1.pdf, mini_bench_hero_v1.png, mini_bench_slide3_fr_v1.pdf. Tag with #mini-bench.
Priya: Accessibility: include alt text for hero and slide descriptions in Figma comments. For French slide, leave at least 10% additional width for line-wrap. I can run quick QA after first pass.
design-bot: Reminder set 48h for first comps upload.
Ivy: I'll post first frames in Figma tonight (frames: HERO_BLOG, SLIDE_METRICS, SLIDE_FLOW, SLIDE_SUMMARY_FR). Ping me for copy tweaks.
Diego: Will export optimized GIF + MP4 for web. If GIF >800KB, we'll use MP4 for blog and static PNG for email.
Noah: Legal note: add tiny footnote: "Based on internal tests; results may vary." No customer logos.
Priya: I'll review FR slide text and accessibility tomorrow morning.
Noah: Thanks everyone 1 please prioritize hero + slide3 FR if time is tight.
